generation.scope: For zero diagonal brackets all 47,492 potential Klein supports reduce to 2,038 orbits, and 2,036 have an explicit monomial quotient of exponential growth. The unique surviving sparse orbit has a two-parameter normal form regular at every nonzero pair, including the square-matrix rank drop. Its two normal regular squares, 128 Laurent diamond identities, full graded basis, and linear self-dual resolution give all-degree certification.

open_mathematics: Resolve the remaining full-support zero-bracket orbit, its Sklyanin and Walsh presentations, then compare unmarked classes of zero-bracket windows and generalize the monomial exclusion to larger branches.
